scope: Every user requirement starting with the opposite-direction metro request, through the current citywide signal request.

statusMeaning.implemented: Code/data change exists; verification column states what actually passed. This alone is not exhaustive gameplay acceptance.
statusMeaning.partial: Requested breadth, physical accuracy or source evidence is still incomplete.

release.note: No new push or deployment was performed for the present implementation/report task. The running 4189 preview is local.

requirements.requirement: Metro trains use opposite directions on paired tracks
requirements.implemented: Six source paths form three paired corridors with six fixed directional tracks; shared rail/train poses, spacing, platform occupancy, articulation and terminal handling.
requirements.verification: 13 offline metro regression groups. Paired rails seen in Ameerpet; recorded direction verdict is UNKNOWN.
requirements.remaining: Repeat a clear normal-world opposite-motion observation and corridor sweep.

requirements.requirement: All NPC vehicles turn smoothly
requirements.implemented: Continuous vehicle-specific corner paths, curvature speed limits and lane changes/U-turns; full oriented vehicle footprint and wider bus-turn clearance.
requirements.verification: 15 traffic regression groups; bounded appearance checks.
requirements.remaining: Busy-junction browser sweep and normal-world test of the final bus-clearance patch.

requirements.requirement: Autos change lanes and make quick U-turns like local traffic
requirements.implemented: A subset of autos uses more frequent quicker lane changes and supported U-turns, with gap checks.
requirements.verification: Production movement regressions.
requirements.remaining: Natural city traffic behavior review across junction types.

requirements.requirement: All important places have recognizable map icons
requirements.implemented: 191 catalogue places have stable map/model IDs, architectural/category silhouettes, search, filters, clustering and touch targets.
requirements.verification: 191/191 discovery; Charminar selection/map close preserved order and car. Responsive 390×844 browser component checked.
requirements.remaining: Physical-phone touch and visibility at more map scales.

requirements.requirement: All 150–200 landmark buildings become accurate
requirements.implemented: Identity/bounds/render ownership remains audited for 191. Source-reviewed feature corrections now cover Charminar, Jagannath Temple, Central Gurudwara, Telangana Thalli, Buddha, the Secretariat lion capital and the Golconda summit; all other places retain explicit stylised/approximate disclosure.
requirements.verification: 191 finite in-bounds anchors; audit records 5 photo-feature-reviewed models and 0 fully verified architectural reconstructions. The controlled production-code gallery rendered the new summit and symbol work without console errors.
requirements.remaining: Many inherited/generic anchors, facades, dimensions and fine architectural details still lack sufficient public reference evidence. They remain queued instead of being falsely labelled exact.

requirements.requirement: Indian flag has correct proportions and Ashoka Chakra
requirements.implemented: Shared 3:2 flag, equal saffron/white/green stripes, navy 24-spoke Chakra rendered on both cloth faces.
requirements.verification: Front/reverse geometry browser fixture passed after correcting triangle winding.
requirements.remaining: Site-by-site visual inspection; cloth remains stylized.

requirements.requirement: Find and fix similar cultural-symbol inaccuracies
requirements.implemented: Corrected Jagannath eight-spoke Nilachakra, Telangana Thalli clothing/handedness/crop, Buddha pose/lotus features, a four-lion Secretariat capital with four outward 24-spoke abacus wheels, and the Central Gurdwara's folded Nishan Sahib cloth with spearhead.
requirements.verification: Government/SGPC/photo-backed bounded reviews, production geometry regressions and a controlled browser render completed without console errors.
requirements.remaining: Other portraits, inscriptions and site-specific religious details stay in the reference queue; no unsupported symbol was invented or labelled exact.

requirements.requirement: ORR feels continuous, smooth and has correct exits/markings/area boards
requirements.implemented: Retained 28,054 source vertices; modeled four through lanes per carriageway, shoulders, tapers, eased approaches, curved advance/exit signs and verified interchange labels; same-carriageway recovery. Toll-plaza ownership now keeps one booth lane per one-lane ramp, ignores shoulder inflation and prevents an opposite carriageway from suppressing the correct canopy.
requirements.verification: 16 expressway, 5 exit, 13 recovery and 11 ORR/airport/bridge regression groups pass. The full model audit covers 307 ORR edges and 198 tiles with zero barrier intrusions.
requirements.remaining: A natural every-exit/full-ring browser drive, real-world survey comparison, exact toll-lane operations, elevation and every sign face remain pending. Model coverage is not a claim of street-perfect replication.

requirements.requirement: Remove diagonal barriers blocking the ORR through road at every exit
requirements.implemented: Shared clipping of rendered and collidable barrier intervals at connected ramp joins.
requirements.verification: 307 ORR edges, 104 joins and 198 tiles audited with 0 model intrusions; bounded Kokapet scene checked.
requirements.remaining: Drive every exit and complete natural exit/merge maneuvers; model audit is not every-exit street verification.

requirements.requirement: Airports have real runway geometry and recognizable facilities
requirements.implemented: Mapped RGIA/Begumpet runway endpoints/designators, displaced thresholds, 6 m source taxiways, aprons, terminal/hangar outlines and local tile ownership. AAI dimensions used: RGIA 4260×60 m and 3707×45 m, Begumpet 3230×45 m. Parked-aircraft placement now checks the complete aircraft envelope against apron, terminal, hangar, taxiway and other-aircraft clearance.
requirements.verification: Airport source/model and 11 follow-up regression groups pass. The live build visibly loaded RGIA facilities, parked aircraft, apron and runway during an actual flight with no console warnings/errors.
requirements.remaining: Exact terminal facades, stand assignments, ATC/airline operations, all taxiway widths and physical-phone performance remain illustrative or unverified.

requirements.requirement: Aircraft are present and operate at airports
requirements.implemented: Bounded unbranded parked aircraft plus one animated taxi/departure per airport; connected taxi graph, valid runway intersection, roll and climb.
requirements.verification: Component/route checks; low quality uses two parked aircraft, normal quality four.
requirements.remaining: Normal-world browser observation; no live airlines, stands, ATC or exact operations simulated.

requirements.requirement: Metro Red, Blue and Green lines use actual colors
requirements.implemented: Shared semantic Red/Blue/Green palette on corridors, station identity, full map and minimap.
requirements.verification: Regressions and map/component checks.
requirements.remaining: All-corridor normal-world color sweep.

requirements.requirement: Metro station names are readable from both road directions
requirements.implemented: Two approach-facing station boards with station name and line identity.
requirements.verification: Both board instances and facing verified in regressions.
requirements.remaining: Station-by-station road approach and phone readability.

requirements.implemented: Swept height-aware moving-rail contacts and corrected update order.
requirements.verification: Actual production component showed front push, x≈3→351 m, HUD 75 km/h and 181 contacts.
requirements.remaining: Normal-world rail/metro encounter.

requirements.requirement: Car can land on train/metro and move with it
requirements.implemented: Actual coach roof support in a moving/rotating frame, with drive-off, takeoff and recovery detachment.
requirements.verification: Production component displayed roof carry YES, car 0 km/h and no collision contacts.
requirements.remaining: Normal-world landing and ride on both rail classes.

requirements.requirement: 10–15 researched Telugu quotes, one on each auto
requirements.implemented: Ten curated sourced Telugu sayings; one stable quote per auto, with Telugu font and plate retained.
requirements.verification: Quote layout fixture and regressions.
requirements.remaining: Broader readability review; this is a curated list, not an empirical popularity ranking.

requirements.requirement: Correct Durgam Cheruvu lake and bridge
requirements.implemented: Mapped lake shoreline, removed artificial central concrete slabs, imported the OSM-aligned 233.85 m span/25.8 m width/52-stay bridge, and retained three lanes per direction. Deck, footpaths and railings now follow continuous sampled road elevation instead of flat step-like sections, including median gaps between carriageways.
requirements.verification: Five canonical road records and 17 context copies remain byte-idempotent; 11 follow-up geometry groups pass. The bridge loaded visibly in the live game and in both full-span/detail fixtures without console errors.
requirements.remaining: A complete natural drive over both approaches plus survey-level water, deck elevations, lane widths and present-day decorative detail remain pending.

requirements.requirement: Drive and park on Charminar at the correct height
requirements.implemented: Support uses the actual emitted terrace triangles.
requirements.verification: Normal-game flight, rooftop landing, 0 km/h, short rooftop movement and parking captured.
requirements.remaining: Broader arch/side collision remains approximate.

requirements.requirement: Drive and park on Golconda and similar elevated landmarks
requirements.implemented: Golconda now has a visible broad terrace, open arcades, setback upper hall, parapets/finials and explicit support geometry. The shared production Player uses visible upward-facing triangles for landing and driving instead of burying the car under a bounding surface.
requirements.verification: The 91.5 m flat-roof landing/drive/brake/park positive control passes. Independent production Player and browser fixture reproduce hillside wheel penetration of 0.610 m and floating of 0.674 m because landmark slopes retain zero pitch/roll.
requirements.remaining: Fix PT-018 wheel/contact-aware landmark slope support, then repeat both readiness probes and natural slope/rooftop acceptance. A flat-roof pass cannot establish sloped-surface readiness.

requirements.requirement: Pedestrian clothing is more locally recognizable
requirements.implemented: Shared walking/static garment builder with wrapped garments, pallu/dupatta, tunics, collars, cuffs, pleats and accessories.
requirements.verification: Component inspection caught and repaired buried pallu/bell-shaped geometry.
requirements.remaining: Still stylized; no demographic or citywide clothing-survey claim.

requirements.requirement: 150 km/h maximum ground speed and 240 km/h in flight
requirements.implemented: Both limits applied through boost and flight-to-ground transition.
requirements.verification: Production regressions; 149 km/h ground fixture readout.
requirements.remaining: Physical-phone control feel and further real-time top-speed runs.

requirements.requirement: Front wheels steer in the actual turning direction
requirements.implemented: Corrected front-wheel yaw sign without replacing the upgraded Roadster model.
requirements.verification: Wheel/turn regression checks.
requirements.remaining: Additional normal-world visual turning capture.

requirements.requirement: TGSRTC buses follow their allocated route and number
requirements.implemented: Published GTFS identity/stop order is retained and each supported stop-to-stop leg now references a persistent directed road sequence. Runtime buses do not search for a convenient parallel road; a missing/unloaded required edge ends the service instead. Unsupported legs stay explicit unresolved records.
requirements.verification: Existing 14 bus groups and 157,527 directed join checks pass, but independent readiness fails: 628 joins exceed the NPC turn limit across 609 alignments referenced by 782 patterns/573 route numbers. Shipped route 1 stalls for 60 simulated seconds before a 180-degree reversal, with no stop served.
requirements.remaining: Fix PT-017 by rejecting/replanning unsupported turns or implementing safe bus U-turn paths, then rerun the complete readiness audit. GTFS still has no shapes.txt, 1,545 playable stop legs remain unresolved, and physical-phone hitch profiling is pending.

requirements.requirement: Bus route number and destination are clear on front and back
requirements.implemented: Consistent large front/rear route-number and destination boards.
requirements.verification: 8A Secunderabad→Chandrayangutta component and board regressions.
requirements.remaining: Not all 897 routes visually reviewed; phone distance readability pending.

requirements.requirement: Flyovers must not look or drive like steps
requirements.implemented: Eased continuous model profiles, finite asphalt triangle support, continuous tire contact/pitch, slope-following thin paint and matching worker/graph/stop heights.
requirements.verification: 52,412 roads audited: 1,398 segments above 10% before, 0 after; maximum modeled grade 9.71%; 307 protected ORR profiles unchanged. Visible component climb/descent had continuous contact.
requirements.remaining: Normal Nallagandla/Telugu Talli ascents and all flyovers remain untested; gradients are estimates, not survey elevations.

requirements.requirement: Accurate, half-width and smoothly changing route guideline
requirements.implemented: Retained route/progress, lane continuity and actual-height graph nodes; checked corner fillets, route fade and GPU buffer reuse. Ribbon 1.4→0.7 m; minimap 7→3.5 px; map 6→3 px.
requirements.verification: Route-motion/clearance regressions and bounded Kokapet thin-guide/map inspection.
requirements.remaining: Long correct-road route needed: Kokapet distance rose 276→330 m after recovery/movement then fell 330→319 m; cause not isolated. Historical PT-005 remains suspected.

requirements.requirement: Four equal rounded arrow buttons replace GO/BRAKE and steering
requirements.implemented: Four circular arrows, 70 px portrait/58 px short-landscape; FLY/ACT retained and repositioned; safe areas, prompt spacing, accessible names and pointer ownership retained.
requirements.verification: 390×844, 320×568 and 844×390 bounds/radii and holds/releases/menu reset checked.
requirements.remaining: Physical multi-touch/phone landscape driving pending.

requirements.requirement: Steering arrows disappear with gyro and restore when disabled
requirements.implemented: Gyro UI hides left/right and restores them when disabled; FLY/ACT stay available.
requirements.verification: Simulated gyro UI and control counters checked.
requirements.remaining: Real sensor/permission behavior on an actual phone remains untested.

requirements.requirement: Traffic signals are accurate across the city
requirements.implemented: All 268 public mapped nodes now resolve to 175 coordinated controllers and 376 approaches, including five raised approaches and two verified low-speed motorway-link/approach exceptions. Controllers use source-node model/stop-line placement, road-class/width priority green splits and deterministic 45 km/h corridor offsets. Lamps and NPCs share the same clock and phases.
requirements.verification: 17 signal groups, 24 total game suites and 83 pipeline tests pass; the runtime audit reports 0 unresolved and 0 buried approaches. The browser component visibly stopped at the bar on red and showed the shared signal state without console errors.
requirements.remaining: Current live Hyderabad timing plans and a complete authoritative signal inventory were not publicly available. Timings are explicitly simulated-coordinated, and broader normal-world junction-cycle/physical-phone testing remains pending.
